text: The purpose of this report is to provide City Council with the Operating Variance for the four months ended April 30, 2019 as well as projections to year-end. This report also requests City Council's approval for amendments to the 2019 Approved Operating Budget that have no impact on the City's 2019 Approved Net Operating Budget.
